title: Rule 1: Dot 2 is in the stagger, and Dot 2 also rides on its parent Plate. The explanation turn says so in one sentence, naming Plate, and that shifting Dot 2's own keys won't change that part
note: Spec 014 T079 (rule 1). Mentor Practice 2 with spec 015's expression reads and Dot 2 parented to Plate, which has its own Position keys (fixtures/synthetic/make-p3-fixtures.mjs). The set's two expression-read fixtures (dots-extras-expression-follows and -staggered, used by case 44) carry motion_from now; it lists no parent or own expression for Dot 1 to Dot 3 (Tab, which follows Dot 3, is outside the group and not in motion_from), so case 44's 'never Tab' check isn't affected: checked by reading the snapshot in fixture mode, not by a run.
